delta.comment: Stage readiness-fix cycle 2 (shipment 143-S / feature 134-F). P1 CORRECTED: the pr-lifecycle exit path ordered 'reply, capture per C2, resolve, residual-risk reference', which contradicted C2 (capture is a precondition for closing the finding) and made C3 unsatisfiable, since a reply cannot cite a deferred entry ID that has not been generated yet. Now mandated as capture-first: C2 capture -> reply citing the generated deferred entry ID -> thread resolution -> residual-risk record, plus an explicit prohibition on replying/resolving before the capture exists. P2 CORRECTED: replaced the bare 'per C2' / 'required payload' references with an explicit six-field capture checklist applied to BOTH skill-template carriers (pr-lifecycle and fix-ci), sourced verbatim from hardening H7 and the authoritative C2 wording in 134.001-T: (1) literal greppable DEFERRED SCOPE EXPANSION token; (2) one-sentence expansion statement; (3) C1-cited out-of-scope rationale; (4) source refs (PR number, review-thread ID when applicable, task ID, feature ID, shipment ID); (5) requires-deliberation flag; (6) kind and provisional priority. Added the H1/H7 provisional-priority / Stage-only-reprioritization criterion for both carriers. Recorded a fix-ci carrier nuance: a CI failure has no review thread, so the C3 thread-reply step is not applicable there and the deferred entry ID is cited in the run/closure residual-risk record instead - a scope-of-applicability difference, not an ordering divergence. CONSISTENCY CHECK across 134.004-T, 134.006-T and 134.007-T: capture order, deferred-entry-ID citation and payload fields now agree across all three carriers; 134.004-T and 134.006-T were already correct and were NOT modified. Scope: backlog documentation only; no template, source, config or manifest changes. Changes left uncommitted for Orchestrator.

Stage fix cycle 3 (2026-08-19, current-HEAD review of 2ec55865, P1). The fix-ci threadless disposition cited the deferred entry ID only in the "run/closure residual-risk record", omitting the TASK-LEVEL citation required by the authoritative C3 in 134.001-T and by 134.004-T's threadless path, both of which name the task-level, run-level AND closure records. This mattered because on a threadless surface those residual-risk citations are the ENTIRE discharge of C3's reference obligation -- there is no thread reply to carry the ID -- so dropping one of the three named records weakened the only mechanism keeping the deferred entry traceable back to the task that spawned it. Corrected in both the fix-ci acceptance criterion and the fix-ci CARRIER NUANCE implementation note to name all three records. Preserved unchanged: the six-field capture payload, per-field source-ID availability (review-thread ID not applicable while the PR number stays concrete), the single-write capture invariant, capture-first ordering, the C5 capture-only role-boundary carve-out, and provisional-priority / Stage-only reprioritization. Targeted consistency check across 134.001-T, 134.004-T, 134.006-T, 134-F, 019-DL and the plan confirms every threadless discharge now names the same three-record set and every thread-present disposition correctly retains the PR/closure form.
